purpose: Teach: 人道/倒す/信徒/激化/国税/紙幣/財界/原動力

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、戦後の人道支援、よく、論じていますね、研究、深いです、本当に。
lines.en: Ren, your paper on post-war humanitarian aid—you argue it very well. The research is really quite deep.
lines.style: Warm, observant attention. Genuine praise landing softly. Slight pause before 'really' — letting the sincerity settle. Steady eye contact, encouraging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上、独裁政権を、倒す動き、複数の地域で、扱いました、論文の中で。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at how different regions worked to overthrow authoritarian regimes throughout history—covered that in the paper.
lines.style: Careful, measured pace. Modest but not defensive. Words chosen precisely. Slight emphasis on 'different regions' — showing he's thought through the scope.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新興宗教の信徒、戦後の社会で、果たした役割、興味深いですね、論文でも、扱いましたね。
lines.en: The role that new religious movements played in post-war society is really fascinating. You addressed that in the paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Genuine intellectual curiosity. Slight lean forward. Tone inviting him to expand. Not testing—actually wanting to know what he found.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経済競争の激化、戦後の日本、特に、急激でしたね、文献から、読み取れます。
lines.en: Yes. The intensification of economic competition in post-war Japan was especially rapid—you can see that clearly in the literature.
lines.style: Slightly quickened pace as he warms to the topic. Conviction building. Speaking with the quiet authority of someone who's read deeply. Not defensive, just present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の国税制度、改革の歴史、論文の重要な部分ですね、よく、扱われていますね。
lines.en: The history of tax reform in the post-war national system is really central to your paper. You've covered it well.
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in her voice. Recognition that he's done substantial work. Steady, grounded delivery—not overstating, but making sure he knows she sees the effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の紙幣制度、戦後、何度も、変わりましたね、混乱を、招いたとも、書きました。
lines.en: Yes. The monetary system changed many times in those early post-war years, and I wrote about how that created real chaos.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but attentive. Building the argument logically. A slight weight on 'chaos'—acknowledging the real human consequence. Not dramatic, just honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後復興、財界の役割、再評価する視点、新鮮ですね、桜さん、新しい論点です、本当に。
lines.en: The perspective of re-evaluating the business world's role in post-war reconstruction—that's really fresh thinking. A genuinely new angle.
lines.style: Slight warmth breaking through. Real delight in finding an original idea. The 'really' carries genuine excitement without becoming effusive. Affirming.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市民の意志こそ、戦後復興の原動力でしたね、論文の結論として、書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I concluded that citizen will itself was the real driving force behind post-war reconstruction.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. The final statement—not rushed, but settled. A pause before delivering the conclusion, as if he's returning to something he believes in. Grounded.
